#Oyingbo
#Idunmota
#TrafficUpdate
We are still enjoying better traffic flow from Carter bridge inward Ijora olopa while traffic from Iddo end inward Oyingbo is good to go.

 Oyingbo is currently experiencing slight traffic occasioned by market activities while officers are on ground doing the needful.

From Oyingbo, traffic is good to go through Adekunle and Alagomeji.

Panti junction is slightly busy as a result of high movement into Panti/ Adekunle police station coupled with the traffic light control.
Sabo through to Agnes still looks good while movement around Jibowu is also good .
Jibowu through to Fadeyi connecting Ikorodu road is calm, so also inward Jibowu from Ikorodu through Yaba to oyingbo.
